HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-10 21:00 PST (session 3d705fec, part C1):
- All 3 epic changes have landed: 3338 (a7e6fb56209), 3340 (06b3b1a5230) and now 3341, merged as 0f02c333bfea741ce00bbafba64e63ae87b92859 at 20:41 PST. real-pubescent-turnstone is closed and signed.
- The flake that blocked 3341, alphabetic-reluctant-dore, is root-caused, fixed and closed.
  - Cause: `_await_probe`'s fixed 3.0 s readiness cap covered the reconciler's pre-review startup work, which a loaded runner can stall for more than 3 s. A 3.5 s injected stall reproduces CI's exact signature; a 2.5 s stall passes.
  - Fix: Gerrit 3343, merged as 02e86fe67db.
- Observation for the production-check owner: both closes over MCP were refused at first. The server's code tree /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code is still at 3835269d792, so the closes needed ref=<landed sha>. This matches the workspace lag already noted on this epic; no new ticket was filed for it.
- Not started (owned by another agent): the production check of the 5.5 upgrade, itchy-neutral-whooper, and the engine-switch plan (skilled-cepevorous-naga).
